title: Locate Megascale Hang Timestamp
description: Locate the exact timestamp of the 'Megascale detects a hang' log message in the coordinator logs.
instruction: gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.pod_name=~"${workload_name}-(worker(s)?|worker-job0|pathways-head)-0-0-.*" AND "Megascale detects a hang"' --project ${project_id} --order=ASC --format="value(timestamp)" --limit=${limit} --freshness=${freshness}

freshness.description: gcloud log-read window. gcloud defaults to 1 day and returns an empty set with exit 0 for anything older, which reads as a real negative. Widen this to reach a historical incident.
